utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Tuesday the twenty-eighth. Can you all hear me, or am I talking to myself again?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, we can hear you. More importantly, there's a birthday cake in the office.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: There is a birthday cake in the office, and apparently that's the main production news this morning.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Depends how many slices you're counting as a batch.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes a cake allocation meeting. What's already out of the way?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I already swapped the filter on the line 3 screw yesterday. That's finished, not another one for today.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Ah, right. I was looking at yesterday's note, then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah. Separate issue, though: the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the line 3 screw. That's still blocked.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: So the delivery's unresolved, but the filter work is done. Two separate bits.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Exactly. Don't want the filter swap following me round all week.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And I already swapped the filter on the dryer yesterday. That one's finished as well.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, saw that marked complete.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Lovely. Just making sure it doesn't get read back as new work.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: PR, can you sort the training records for the new starters this morning? No rush.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Um, yeah. No rush as in not an immediate interruption, but still this morning?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. This morning, just not a drop-everything job.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Fine, I'll sort the training records for the new starters this morning.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Got you. Morning deadline, without the panic attached.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fi, can you write up the near miss at the line one? Due tomorrow, but that one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll start straight away and have the write-up done by tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, the safety-critical bit matters there. Tomorrow isn't a reason to leave it sitting.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's what I mean. Immediate attention, write-up due tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Understood. I've got the line one near miss.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: While we're on the lines—sorry, were you finished? What's the scope on the robot jam?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep. Callum, can you clear the jam and check the sensors on the Line 2 Pick and Place Robot? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll clear the jam and check the sensors on the Line 2 Pick and Place Robot. Both bits, understood.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That's the physical job, not the purchase order discussion, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct. Callum's taking the jam and sensor check, not the purchasing bit.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: That purchasing bit does still need someone to chase the purchase order for the pick and place on two. Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anyone able to take that one?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Not me, sorry. I can take the records, but I'm not taking the purchase order chase as well.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I haven't got room for it either. Raising it isn't me volunteering, just to be clear.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fair enough. Nobody's taken it, then. It's still needed and unowned; let's not pretend it's covered.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, so, on mine: I'll recalibrate the sensors on the line 3 chiller by tomorrow morning. Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Sorry, sensors on the chiller? Teams clipped the middle of that.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: The line 3 chiller, yeah. Recalibrating the sensors.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, Marcus Hale has that, due tomorrow morning. Not an emergency, but it needs to stay on track.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep, that's mine.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I'll inspect the booster pump for leaks as well. By next Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Grace. Drop everything for that one. The due point is next Tuesday, but it's the top-priority one.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Understood. I'll treat the booster pump inspection as drop-everything priority and get it done by next Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sorry—next Tuesday, not today? Just checking I heard the date.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Next Tuesday is the deadline, yes. The priority doesn't change that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Urgency and due date both captured, then.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And I'll run the monthly fire alarm test on Friday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Grace Liu for the monthly fire alarm test on Friday.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yep, I'll do that.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: On alarms, just an observation: noticed the Fire Alarm Panel was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: It settled down, yeah? You're not raising a separate job off that?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: No, just passing on what was noticed. It settled down. Not asking for another job today.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Good to distinguish it. Otherwise the word 'alarm' gets said and everyone stops breathing.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, quick check of what's actually agreed, rather than everything we've mentioned.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Nothing new against me. The line 3 screw filter was yesterday's finished work.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, and the supplier delivery is still a blocker, not a fresh action we've allocated here.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I've got the Line 2 Pick and Place Robot jam and sensors. Matters, not urgent. No purchase order attached to me.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Training records for the new starters, this morning, no rush. That's mine.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And mine's the line one near miss write-up. Safety critical, starting straight away, due tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Line 3—sorry, the line 3 chiller sensors for me. Recalibrated by tomorrow morning. Not an emergency, won't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Booster pump leak inspection, drop-everything priority, by next Tuesday. And the monthly fire alarm test on Friday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Only loose one is chasing the purchase order for the pick and place on two. Not an emergency but don't let it slip; still nobody owning it.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, leave that visibly unowned. We haven't agreed someone for it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right. At least the cake's got universal support.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: First unanimous decision of the morning. Cheers, everyone, we'll leave it there.
